slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers 54-country review, an AI-assisted compilation by its own header, scores Botswana's rural police stations 1 and says they predominantly record case files, complaints and incident reports on paper, with no evidence found of digital recording at rural level; the document dates the statement no closer than its publication, 2026-03-31.

The same review says the Occurrence Book is the standard paper tool for logging crimes at stations, that police procedures remain manual, especially in rural areas, and that central systems such as criminal records rely on paper inputs from stations; undated in the document, so its publication date of 2026-03-31 is used.

systems.tiers: police stations, as the review states it
central, fed by paper inputs from stations
